props.name: value
props.meaning: The stored instant, UTC. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: on_value_change
props.meaning: Called when either input commits or a day is picked.

props.name: field
props.meaning: Supplies the accessible label and the required flag.

props.name: time_zone
props.meaning: IANA zone the typed wall-clock time is read in.

props.name: show_seconds
props.meaning: Seconds in the time input and on the button.

props.name: hint
props.meaning: Name the zone under the button.

props.name: readonly
props.meaning: Keeps the value readable and does not open the popover.

props.name: error
props.meaning: A message from the caller, shown in place of the parse error.

props.name: on_error_change
props.meaning: Called when the parse error appears or clears.

props.name: placeholder
props.meaning: Shown on the button and in the typed day while the field is unset.

props.name: open
props.meaning: Whether the calendar popover is showing. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: error_message
props.meaning: Renders the message. Default is a small destructive line under the control.

props.name: inline
props.meaning: The row form: the button takes the width of its value and the zone line goes.

keyboard.does: On the button, opens the popover. In the typed day or the time, commits both and closes the popover.
In the popover, restores the stored instant and closes the popover.
Opens the popover, from the button.
Moves through the typed day, the calendar and the time.
Move between days inside the calendar, and between segments inside the time.
